summary: Delta 1f6c977..HEAD closes all three round-2 blocking findings with no FR regression. SEC-1: models-record now takes --from <path> or stdin and refuses inline argv JSON (cli.py:146-163), SKILL.md:47 preflight prose documents the temp-file/stdin transport and never interpolates model values into shell syntax, and test_models_record_reads_stdin_and_refuses_inline_json proves the adversarial apostrophe payload records verbatim with no marker file - FR-005/FR-009 remain satisfied through the single state writer (test_records_pending_and_worktree_with_resume_delta re-passed via --from, previous/current resume disclosure intact). SPEC-1/SEC-4: _read_models refuses control-character values naming file and tier key (models.py:52-56) and report()/README output masks them (_sanitize, models.py:80-82,101), extending the FR-002/FR-008 malformed-config rule consistently with spec wording (Story-2 scenario 2 stop naming file, offending selection, correction). SPEC-2/SEC-3/STD-1/STD-2: init stages both artifacts, publishes config.README.md first and config.json last as the commit point via no-replace os.link (models.py:144-160), a destination appearing in the race window is refused and rolled back with the other writer's config.json bytes preserved (test_publish_race_refuses_without_clobber), any other OSError converts to ModelConfigError and removes created artifacts making init retryable (test_readme_failure_rolls_back_and_converts_oserror), the cli.py init handler converts FileExistsError to CLIError(1) naming the path so FR-014 refusal semantics hold, and the FR-013 stale-README rewrite regression (test_init_replaces_stale_readme_and_accepts_empty_directory) is intact; tools.tests.test_models 18/18 green. All three verdict-driven fix commits (40cfef7 SEC-1, eafee1b SPEC-1/SEC-4, 0931f77 SPEC-2/SEC-3/STD-1/STD-2) carry well-formed form-1 Red: lines naming real tests. One low advisory: the refused/masked control-character range is C0+DEL only, leaving C1 controls unrefused against the unquantified confirmed-scope wording.

findings.summary: Confirmed-scope failure path 'control-character model values refused (resolve + table sanitize)' is implemented for C0 and DEL only: C1 control characters (U+0080-U+009F) stay accepted by resolve and unmasked in the table/README output (partial coverage of the declared scope, ENG-18); advisory per the judgement ceiling because the exploitable terminal set (ESC/CR/LF/BEL/NUL/DEL) is refused, tested, and mainstream UTF-8 terminals do not execute C1 sequences
findings.evidence: plan.md 'Test seams (fix round 1 scope - orchestrator-confirmed 2026-11-02)' declares 'control-character model values refused (resolve + table sanitize)' without restricting the range, and the round-2 remedy text named C0/C1. models.py:52-56 refuses only ord(ch) < 0x20 or ch == '\x7f' and _sanitize (models.py:80-82) masks the identical range, so a project value such as 'x\u009bc' (U+009B CSI) passes _read_models and reaches the 'factory models' table and the init config.README.md raw; tools/tests/test_models.py test_refuses_control_character_model_values and test_table_sanitizes_control_characters assert only [\x00-\x1f\x7f]. No demonstrated exploit, so advisory scope-completeness rather than missing coverage: refusal and sanitize exist and are tested for the dangerous set.
findings.fix: Extend both the refusal predicate and _sanitize through the C1 range (ord(ch) < 0x20 or 0x7f <= ord(ch) <= 0x9f) and add a C1 case to both tests, or record C0+DEL as the accepted interpretation of the confirmed scope through the orchestrator.
